label: Diagram 3.4
caption: Diagram 3.4 Fire resistance of areas near to external stairs
description: Diagram 3.4, titled "Fire resistance of areas near to external stairs", begins top left with "See para 3.32". Example a. is a green-shaded cross-section of an external stair with flights and landings. Top labels read "No fire resistance required for door" and "Fire resisting window (minimum RE 30)"; left dimension "1100mm above top landing"; "9m below stair flights and landings" on the left; "1800mm" appears on the top right, middle right and lower left; "Fd" marks door sets; right text reads "Ground level or a roof or podium served by an independent stairway". A left legend defines "Fd Fire doorset (minimum E 30)" and the green shade as "Fire resisting construction (minimum RE 30)". Example b. shows a narrow vertical "Section A–A" labelled "1800mm" and a diagonal "Section B–B" repeating the 1100mm, Fd, 1800mm, 9m and ground-level labels. Below, a "Plan" view carries two "1800mm" dimensions and section markers A and B. A NOTE cites para 3.31 and 3.32d.
